elements_selected.content: Define the core data types for SPL extraction and reasoning in src/types.rs (or a new src/reason/types.rs if gated). Implement: SplBlock { source_file, source_page, start_line, end_line, content }, ProvenancedRule { label, rule_type, body, head, source_file, source_line, source_page }, ProvenancedFact { literal, source_file, source_line, source_page }, ProvenancedConclusion { literal, conclusion_type, proof_sources }, ProofSource { page, path, line, rule_label, contribution }, ConclusionType enum (+D, -D, +d, -d). All types derive Serialize for JSON output. Per SPEC-005 §5.3 data model.
Modified 4 files (+285, -0): Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/reason.rs
